methodology.firstSeen: First successful Raven Eye observation, not the original release date.
methodology.publishedAt: Seller publication timestamp when exposed; not a verified mint launch date.
methodology.status: Seller feed observation at lastCheckedAt; a source outage or absent listing never implies sold out.
methodology.prices: Original seller currency; taxes, shipping, quantity tiers and local storefront conversion may differ. No currency conversion.
methodology.maker: Reported brand/vendor or an explicit maker attribute from the seller's feed; not independent verification of the physical manufacturer.
methodology.coverage: Automatic sources refresh bounded primary catalogue windows (at most four pages). Selected sources also scan focused collections and rotating deeper pages, each with a separate fixed budget. A capped window or scan is not complete catalogue coverage. Older WooCommerce and WordPress listings are rechecked in rotation; Shopify stock checks advance only when a listing reappears in a public collection or catalogue feed. Directory entries have no automatic product monitoring. Missing listings retain historical observations; this is not an exhaustive catalogue of every maker or release.
methodology.baseline: Initial source and focused-collection imports, plus discoveries only in rotating older catalogue pages, do not create new-release alerts. New means first detected outside those baseline imports; it does not verify a mint release date.
